$comment: Model strategies the eval harness compares. `runner` picks the adapter in runners/. `models` maps a logical role to a Claude alias; `coderRunner` says whether implementation runs in the main session or is delegated to a sonnet coder-subagent. Decide on data: success rate > cost > latency.

baseline.description: Legacy command-center pipeline. Backend drives phases and switches models per phase (analysis/spec/review=opus, implementation/revising=sonnet, pr/docs=haiku). Kept for a regression flip.

autonomous-backend.description: Phase 3 proof: backend spawns ONE self-driving agent (opus brain + sonnet coder subagents + opus review subagent) and only observes it via progress reports. Same lifecycle skill + Stop-hook gate the standalone runner proved — but driven through the real backend.

opus-everywhere.description: Standalone agent. Main session on Opus for the whole task (analysis/spec/impl/ui/docs). Review delegated to an opus subagent purely for fresh, unbiased context.

opus-orchestrator.description: Standalone agent, orchestrator-workers. Opus 'brain' main session does research/spec/review/coordination; implementation is delegated to Sonnet coder-subagents (implement+test+green, return diff). Review = opus subagent.
